justification: Scientific integrity mandates that supervised next-24-hour temporal landslide prediction cannot be fabricated or simulated with synthetic labels. With only 38 news-reported events over 17 years, zero sub-daily timestamps, 1-50 km coordinate uncertainties, and a cell-day positive prevalence of < 1 in 160,000, training a temporal GRU/MLP classifier would produce an unscientific, severely overfitted artifact. The platform correctly preserves dynamic hazard assessment as a decision matrix coupling static geomorphometry with antecedent rainfall accumulations, rather than misrepresenting static susceptibility as a temporal forecast.

criterion_1_temporal_resolution.requirement: Sub-daily or hourly event initiation timestamps for causal rainfall integration
criterion_1_temporal_resolution.failure_impact: Cannot align sub-daily rainfall bursts; 24h window timing ambiguity of +/- 12 hours

criterion_2_spatial_precision.requirement: Accurately delineated scarp boundary polygons or GPS sub-km coordinates
criterion_2_spatial_precision.available: 0 of 55 events <= 1 km; 55 events > 10 km uncertainty
criterion_2_spatial_precision.failure_impact: Severe coordinate noise washes out 90m slope physics (XGB ROC-AUC drops to 0.53-0.59)

criterion_3_temporal_data_overlap.requirement: Concurrent high-resolution satellite/radar predictor sequences during historical events
criterion_3_temporal_data_overlap.available: 0 events occurred during the 14-day weather pilot archive
criterion_3_temporal_data_overlap.failure_impact: Precipitation histories (IMERG/MERGIR) unavailable for 2007-2023 event catalog

criterion_4_class_imbalance.requirement: Defensible positive-to-negative sample ratio avoiding catastrophic false alarms
criterion_4_class_imbalance.available: Positive prevalence = 8.37e-06 (1 positive per 119,454 negative cell-days)
criterion_4_class_imbalance.failure_impact: Supervised GRU/MLP sequence classifier collapses to all-zero trivial majority solution

criterion_5_independent_holdout.requirement: Sufficient chronological and spatial events for robust multi-fold evaluation
criterion_5_independent_holdout.available: Mean 3.1 events per year across entire state
criterion_5_independent_holdout.failure_impact: Test folds contain < 5 events, yielding statistically meaningless AUC confidence bounds

prerequisites_for_future_operational_for: Official Geological Survey of India (GSI) Bhukosh National Landslide Susceptibility Mapping (NLSM) polygon database
Automated in-situ slope sensor telemetry (piezometers, inclinometers, volumetric soil water content)
Multi-decadal calibrated hourly satellite precipitation reanalysis (IMERG V07B 2000-present)
Automated continuous ingestion pipeline for prospective NWP/IMERG Early Run precipitation grids
